title: 9th Day
categoryChain: Everyday short duas in the month of Ramadhan

verses.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ اجْعَلْ لِيْ فِيْهِ نَصِيْبًا مِنْ رَحْمَتِكَ الْوَاسِعَةِ،
verses.translation: O Allah, on this day, (please) decide for me a share from Your expansive mercy,
guide me on this day to Your luminous proofs,
and take me from the forelock to Your all-inclusive satisfaction,
in the name of Your lovingness, O hope of the eager ones!
